mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 1.0% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 4.5% indicates tightening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand, increasing corporate revenues and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% signals high inflation, triggering market anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding supply capacity and economic growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO rises (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1250.0 thousand units signals strong residential demand, boosting construction sector activity and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST > 1250.0 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in payrolls indicates rapidly strengthening labor market, increasing consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production growth below 0.5% annually signals industrial slowdown, increasing recession risks and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO growth < 0.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).
